ad_library.summary: Meissa Reeve is running exactly one active Meta ad, on the page 'Meissa Reeve' (facebook.com/61596697943588), started 14 Nov 2026 and about 18 hours old when it was re-checked. The click lands on a WhatsApp deep link, never on meissareeve.com. Google Ads Transparency for meissareeve.com returns 0 ads under region=IN, so Meta is the entire paid channel and it rests on a single creative.

defects.title: 36 unedited theme-demo pages are live and indexed
defects.detail: The sitemap at meissareeve.com/sitemap_index.xml lists 17 sub-sitemaps, and page-sitemap.xml alone contains 79 page URLs. 36 of them are untouched theme demo content: /my-account/, /checkout/, /cart/, /gallery-2-columns/, /gallery-3-columns/, /gallery-4-columns/, sixteen /elements/* pages, /404-layout/, /multipage/, /shop/, and four complete demo homepages - /homepage-gas-station/, /homepage-rental/, /homepage-towing/ and /homepage-natural-honey/ - plus product pages for three EV scooter brands (/komaki/, /gemopai/, /virtus-motors/) and /petrol-pumps/ and /airport-metros/. A prospect who follows a link can land on a page selling petrol pumps or honey. All of it is in the sitemap, so all of it is indexable.

defects.title: The phone number and email are published as plain text, not links
defects.detail: meissareeve.com/contacts/ shows +91-7893088071 and info@meissareeve.com as bare text. Neither is wrapped in a tel: or mailto: link, so a visitor on a phone - which is most of them for a local solar enquiry - cannot tap to call or tap to email. The email address is published, so the lead qualifies, but the click path is missing.

defects.title: The homepage has no H1, and 10 of its 12 images carry no alt text
defects.detail: Counted over the page text read on 2026-11-15: meissareeve.com renders 12 images, 10 of them with an empty alt attribute, and no H1 heading at all. The solar division is markedly better - 44 images with only 3 missing alt, and one H1 - so this is the parent site being left unpolished rather than a site-wide problem.

defects.title: The solar division homepage has no action CTA anywhere
defects.detail: re.meissareeve.com renders 50 links. Not one of them is an action - no 'get a quote', no 'book a site visit', no 'contact us'. The links are internal anchors, image links to full-size photos and social icons. The page explains on-grid, off-grid and hybrid systems and lists twelve installations, then gives the reader nothing to click.

defects.title: Image URLs are listed as sitemap entries
defects.detail: page-sitemap.xml interleaves raw /wp-content/uploads/ image URLs among the page URLs. That is a WordPress SEO plugin misconfiguration: it tells search engines that media files are indexable pages, which splits the site's ranking signal across hundreds of thin URLs.

defects.title: A public view counter is displayed on the solar division
defects.detail: re.meissareeve.com prints '11,020 total views, 10 views today' at the top of the page. That is an internal traffic metric published to every visitor, and 10 views a day is not a number worth advertising.
